title: THE TITLE MUSIC PLAYS THREE VARIATIONS IN TURN
why: His round 2 answer 2.70 c: the idle loop should use three variations of the piece in turn. THE ASCENT now plays as written, then with the tune half a bar later in each bar, then a quarter bar later, and round again. Same notes and chords, so it stays one piece.
now: The title and idle music changes its tune placement every pass through three variations.

edits.replacement: var m=musLeadAt(T,B,si);   // v28.xx (cw-musicvar): the tune of this pass
var _adv=musAdvance(MUS.step,_len,MUS.pass,T); MUS.step=_adv.step; MUS.pass=_adv.pass;   // v28.xx (cw-musicvar): three variations in turn
